events.title: Jujutsu Kaisen: The Culling Game × Yomiuriland & HANA·BIYORI

events.tagline: A whole amusement park goes cursed for six weeks.
events.station: Keio-yomiuriland Sta. (Keio Sagamihara Line) · about 1.4 km uphill to the park gate (~24 min walk)
events.overview: Yomiuriland amusement park and the neighbouring HANA·BIYORI garden run a Jujutsu Kaisen "Culling Game" collaboration with newly drawn mini-character art. The park adds collab goods, a stamp rally, themed food, a kitchen car, workshops and character voice lines on five rides; HANA·BIYORI has a word rally and mini game. Joining the event requires park admission.
details: Yomiuriland (amusement park) and HANA·BIYORI. Goods, stamp rally start/goal and the bonus counter are inside the park; the two sites connect via a gate open from 11:00
Same as Yomiuriland's opening hours (vary by day; check the park's site)

Event participation needs Yomiuriland admission. Advance-only SP One-Day Pass (park one-day pass + HANA·BIYORI entry + hologram postcard): adults ¥5,700, ages 12–17 ¥4,500, elementary/seniors ¥3,900, preschool ¥2,300 — sold online on Yomiran CLUB until Dec 13 20:00, not at the ticket windows. Regular admission price: see the park's site

Sold at the Aurora Space in the GOODJOB!! area (same lineup at HANA·BIYORI): random clear cards from ¥440, can badges ¥550–660, acrylic stands ¥1,430, acrylic figures ¥1,980, face towels ¥3,300, extra-large tapestries ¥8,800 and more. One random bromide per ¥2,000 spent
¥1,100 per sheet (max 3 per purchase); collect all stamps in the park for a clear shikishi (5 designs, random)

Itadori's Black Flash mapo tofu rice bowl ¥1,300, Megumi's ten-topping tonkotsu miso ramen ¥1,500, Yuta's stew ¥800, Choso's chocolate churros ¥850, Higuruma's cheese fries ¥850 (bonus bromide Nov 6–23, placemat Nov 24–Dec 13, random, while stocks last). Plus a collab kitchen car near CAR factory

Ride tie-ins with recorded character voices (Spin Runway, Bandit, Hero Training Center, Sweets Cup, Fight Ippatsu); workshops ¥400–800; at HANA·BIYORI a word rally ¥900, mini game ¥700 and a lucky-draw ¥500
events.nearby: Yomiuriland is an amusement park on a hill in Inagi, western Tokyo. HANA·BIYORI is next door and connects to the park through a gate (open from 11:00); the SP pass covers both.

events.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Exhibition: The Final (Shinjuku)
events.jp: 芥見下々『呪術廻戦』完結展（新宿会場）
events.tagline: The touring JJK exhibition ends where the final battle was fought.
events.station: Tochomae Sta. (Toei Oedo Line) · about 1 min walk; JR Shinjuku Sta. · about 15 min walk
events.overview: The final stop of Gege Akutami's touring Jujutsu Kaisen exhibition opens in West Shinjuku, the setting of the manga's final battle, with a new key visual of Yuta Okkotsu and Rika. A new area, "Domain of ≡", covers the making of the spin-off Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo, including Akutami's own name (storyboard) drafts. The official shop adds new goods and a supplementary catalogue.
details: Shinjuku Sumitomo Building, Triangle Square (三角広場)
東京都新宿区西新宿2-6-1 新宿住友ビル 三角広場

Timed entry (date + hourly slot). Adults ¥2,200, junior/senior high ¥1,600, age 4 to elementary ¥1,000; ticket with the acrylic diorama goods ¥4,600 (limited). Audio guide (Japanese only, on your own phone with earphones) included. Plus e+ fees (¥110 per ticket issued)

Paper tickets from e+ only, printed at FamilyMart before you go — no tickets sold at the venue. Advance lottery on the e+ website Oct 26 – Nov 8 (e+ membership needs a Japanese mobile number); first-come general sale from Nov 21, 12:00, also at FamilyMart multi-copy machines. If a slot is not sold out you can buy on the day until that slot starts

Shop entry only after the exhibition (no shop-only visits). New items include an acrylic card set ¥1,540, Domain Expansion tote (Itadori) ¥5,280, "MEMORIES" can badges ¥660 (random), acrylic MEGA figure ¥4,400 and catalogue supplement ¥1,540. Cash (yen), major credit cards, IC cards and QR payments accepted

Displays are in Japanese only and translation apps are not allowed; photos only at designated spots, no video. No suitcases or large luggage and no cloakroom — use station lockers. Two random stickers per visitor
events.nearby: The venue is in the West Shinjuku skyscraper district, a short walk from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building and its free observation decks. Busy Shinjuku station area shopping is about 15 minutes away on foot.
